Priya Shah: Heads up — onsite candidate Alex Chen, Wed 3/25 10:00am PT. Samir, I see you have a recurring call that puts you out 10:15–11:00. Can we confirm coverage for the second half of your system-design slot? I can reassign debrief owner if needed.
Samir Patel: yep, apologies. calendar clash I missed. I can do the first 15 min of system-design (10:00–10:15) then need to hop. @Nate Liu can you take 10:15–10:45? I can cover async notes after.
Nate Liu: I can take 10:15–10:40. Do you want me to focus on design + performance Qs or do coding whiteboard too?
Samir Patel: prioritize design + perf, leave coding prompt if time — leave the takehome eval anchor we agreed on.
Elena Gomez: I can move my rubric slot earlier by 10 minutes and then run the debrief if that's helpful. Happy to be debrief owner.
Maya K: quick rubric question — we had agreed system-design is weighted 30%, coding 35%, takehome 35% for this role. Is that still the plan? need to document before the panel.
Priya Shah: yes that's still the weights. @people_ops_bot can you attach the rubric link and update calendar attendee note about the partial swap?
people_ops_bot: attached rubric: https://redwood.example.com/rubrics/eng_sde_level2 — calendar note updated: Samir partial (10:00–10:15), Nate covers 10:15–10:40, Elena debrief owner. :white_check_mark:
Nate Liu: got it. can someone drop the short prompt I'll use into the shared doc? I'll paste after this thread.
Samir Patel: pasted prompt in doc: `Design a cache invalidation strategy for a global session store` — also added 2 perf probes.
Priya Shah: perfect. final checklist: 1) rubric link in calendar (done), 2) Nate assigned on calendar (done), 3) Elena debrief owner (done), 4) Samir will add notes to doc (Samir: confirm done).
Samir Patel: done — notes saved. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maya K: thanks — I updated the rubric sheet with the weightings and scoring anchors.
Priya Shah: great, closing thread. see y'all Wed. :wave:
